snippet.title: Truck Night in America AR
snippet.description: Based on the hit History Channel unscripted series! Create and customize your own truck in AR, tweaking colors, decals and adding a variety of other modifications. Fire up your engine, and spray mud all over the place! Take part in community mod challenges, and upload your custom truck for voting!
